title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity of Deterministic Agnostic PAC Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of agnostic PAC learning under deterministic labels, where the examples are labeled by an arbitrary deterministic function, which need not belong to the concept class $C$. This model captures misspecification without stochastic label noise and lies between the realizable and fully agnostic settings. Prior work showed that, when $C$ has finite diameter $K$ and VC dimension $d$, deterministic labels can improve the sample complexity upper bound from the classical agnostic guarantee $O(d/\varepsilon^2)$ to $\widetilde{O}(K/\varepsilon)$, but left a large gap between upper and lower bounds. Our main result sharpens this picture. We prove that every class of VC dimension $d$ and finite diameter $K$ is learnable with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left( \frac{K^{1/3} \, d^{2/3}}{\varepsilon} \right)$, and we construct classes for which this bound is tight up to logarithmic factors. translated_title: 确定性不可知PAC学习的近最优样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究确定性标签下的不可知PAC学习问题，其中样本由任意确定性函数标注，该函数不必属于概念类 $C$。该模型刻画了不含随机标签噪声的模型误设情形，介于可实现设定与完全不可知设定之间。先前的工作表明，当概念类 $C$ 具有有限直径 $K$ 和VC维 $d$ 时，确定性标签可以将样本复杂度上界从经典的不可知保证 $O(d/\varepsilon^2)$ 改进到 $\widetilde{O}(K/\varepsilon)$，但上下界之间存在较大差距。我们的主要结果使这一图景更加清晰：我们证明，每一个VC维为 $d$ 且直径有限为 $K$ 的概念类都可以以样本复杂度 $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{K^{1/3} d^{2/3}}{\varepsilon}\right)$ 进行学习，并且我们构造了使该界在对数因子范围内紧的概念类。我们还研究了其在线版本的对应问题。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了VC维为 $d$、直径为 $K$ 的概念类在确定性标签下的不可知PAC学习样本复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}(K^{1/3} d^{2/3}/\varepsilon)$，并构造了对数因子内紧的下界，填补了此前上下界之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that any concept class with VC dimension $d$ and finite diameter $K$ is agnostically PAC learnable under deterministic labels with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}(K^{1/3} d^{2/3}/\varepsilon)$, and constructs matching lower bounds up to logarithmic factors, closing the gap between prior upper and lower bounds.
